name: Google Safe Browsing Lookup API v4 (non-commercial)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms (A8): 'Google: tier trusted.' (P067 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Google's Safe Browsing lists: a hit is usually right; a miss reads 'not on Google's lists at <time>', never 'safe' (P067 cond 5). Same upstream lists as Web Risk: one vote in consensus.

google_safebrowsing.description: Google Safe Browsing v4 API key (non-commercial use only: research profile or a licence_allow entry); sent as the 'key' URL parameter and masked by the central redactor (AR01)
google_safebrowsing.plan_hint: non-commercial terms: never used under the corporate profile without a licence_allow entry; commercial users go to Web Risk (key 'webrisk', P067 cond 2)

v4_lookup.title: Safe Browsing Lookup API v4 threatMatches:find (POST JSON, URL list): MALWARE, SOCIAL_ENGINEERING, UNWANTED_SOFTWARE

terms.quote: Safe Browsing v4/v5 (noncommercial; v4 deprecated; Google sends commercial users to Web Risk) runs only through licence_allow or the research profile.

v4_lookup.notes: Quote: binding council text (P067 cond 2). Research C0147 (verified_needs_key): keyless POST answers 403 PERMISSION_DENIED (ErrorInfo ACCESS_DENIED), an invalid key 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT 'API key not valid' -> NEEDS_KEY (P067 cond 6); an empty {} answer means no match. The minimised URL (P067 cond 4) is the only value sent.
v4_lookup.licensed_alternative: Google Web Risk (google_webrisk.uris_search, class 'license'): a company billing account recorded in licence_allow and key 'webrisk' (P067 cond 1).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G03-1 (P067 google_safe_browsing). Key name google_safebrowsing is the legacy config.KNOWN_KEYS name (alias GOOGLE_SAFEBROWSING_KEY); V3LUM_GSB_KEY is added as an alias. Free quota per Google Cloud project: no quota block.
